article.title: Shopping at a Drugstore: Products and Returns

paragraphs.en: Emma visits a drugstore near her hotel. She needs sunscreen, shampoo, and a small bottle of hand cream. She cannot find the sunscreen, so she asks an employee for help. 'Excuse me, where can I find sunscreen?' she says. The employee points to the second aisle and explains that several products are on the top shelf. Emma thanks her and walks to the aisle. She sees many bottles with different labels. She wants a product that is easy to carry during her trip.
paragraphs.zh: 艾瑪到飯店附近的藥妝店，需要防曬乳、洗髮精和小瓶護手霜。她找不到防曬乳，便向店員詢問位置。店員指向第二排貨架，說有些商品在上層。她道謝後前往查看，看到許多不同標籤的瓶子，想找旅行時容易攜帶的產品。
paragraphs.ja: エマはホテル近くのドラッグストアで日焼け止め、シャンプー、ハンドクリームを探しています。日焼け止めが見つからず店員に尋ねます。二番目の通路の上段にあると教えてもらい、旅行に持ち運びやすい商品を選ぼうとします。

paragraphs.en: Emma reads the labels carefully. She asks, 'Do you have a smaller size?' The employee shows her a travel-size bottle and explains the price. Emma also asks whether the sunscreen is suitable for sensitive skin. The employee suggests reading the ingredient list and checking the manufacturer's information. She does not promise that the product will work for everyone. Emma decides to buy the smaller bottle. She also chooses shampoo and hand cream. Before paying, she notices a sign about returns and exchanges near the register.
paragraphs.zh: 艾瑪仔細閱讀標籤，詢問有沒有小容量。店員展示旅行裝並說明價格。她又問敏感肌是否適用，店員建議查看成分及製造商資訊，不保證所有人都適合。艾瑪選了小瓶防曬乳、洗髮精和護手霜，結帳前看到收銀台附近的退換貨公告。
paragraphs.ja: エマは表示を読み、小さいサイズがあるか尋ねます。店員は旅行用サイズと価格を案内します。敏感肌に合うかについては成分表示とメーカー情報を確認するよう勧めます。レジの近くで返品・交換の案内も見つけます。

paragraphs.en: At the register, Emma asks, 'Can I return this if I do not open it?' The cashier explains that the store has specific rules and that some personal care items may not be returnable. He tells her to keep the receipt and check the conditions before leaving. Emma asks whether a damaged item can be exchanged. The cashier explains the procedure for reporting a problem. Emma understands that rules can be different at other stores. She pays by card and puts the receipt in her wallet.
paragraphs.zh: 收銀台前，艾瑪問未拆封能否退貨。收銀員解釋店內有特定規則，有些個人護理用品可能無法退貨，建議保留收據並確認條件。她再問商品損壞能否換貨，收銀員說明申報程序。艾瑪知道各店規則可能不同，刷卡付款並收好收據。
paragraphs.ja: レジでエマは未開封なら返品できるか尋ねます。店員は店舗ごとに条件があり、衛生用品などは返品できない場合もあると説明します。不良品の交換手順も聞き、レシートを財布にしまってカードで支払います。

paragraphs.en: Later, Emma checks her shopping bag and finds that one bottle has a loose cap. She does not use the product. She returns to the store with the bottle and receipt and politely explains the problem. The employee examines the item and follows the store's exchange procedure. Emma receives a replacement after the employee confirms the issue. She learns three useful lessons: ask about the right product, check the return policy before buying, and keep proof of purchase. These simple questions make shopping in an unfamiliar place easier.
paragraphs.zh: 稍後艾瑪發現一個瓶蓋鬆動，沒有使用商品，帶著瓶子和收據回店裡禮貌說明。店員檢查並依換貨程序處理，確認問題後提供替換品。她學到三件事：詢問合適商品、購買前確認退換規則、保留購買證明。
paragraphs.ja: 後で一本のふたが緩いと気づき、使用せずに商品とレシートを持って店に戻ります。店員が確認して交換手続きを行います。商品について質問し、購入前に返品条件を確認し、購入証明を保管する大切さを学びます。
